Ui.Script:
-- A pushable above every stock panel's, so a game window opening pushes the log aside. UIPanelWindows["BenillaScriptLogFrame"] = { area = "left", pushable = 9, whileDead = 1 }
-- The class trainer's rows (`CLASS_TRAINER_SKILLS_DISPLAYED`, Blizzard_TrainerUI.lua:470). BENILLA_SCRIPTLOG_ROWS = 11 BENILLA_SCRIPTLOG_ROW_HEIGHT = 16 -- A wrapped row would break the faux kit's fixed rows. BENILLA_SCRIPTLOG_ROW_CHARS = 52 -- The detail box's inset from its pane's top, which its anchor in the child sets. BENILLA_SCRIPTLOG_DETAIL_INSET = 6
-- A `seq`, not an index: indices shift when the cap evicts. BenillaScriptLogSelected = nil
-- Distinct messages kept before the oldest is evicted. BENILLA_SCRIPTLOG_CAP = 256 -- Rows oldest first, each { seq, message, count }; `total` is the last `seq` handed out, -- kept apart from the row count so an eviction or a clear never renumbers. BenillaScriptLog = { rows = {}, total = 0 }
-- A repeat bumps its row's count and keeps its place. function BenillaScriptLog_Record(message) if type(message) ~= "string" then message = tostring(message) end local log = BenillaScriptLog local found = nil for i = 1, table.getn(log.rows) do if log.rows[i].message == message then found = log.rows[i] end end if found then found.count = found.count + 1 else log.total = log.total + 1 if table.getn(log.rows) >= BENILLA_SCRIPTLOG_CAP then table.remove(log.rows, 1) end table.insert(log.rows, { seq = log.total, message = message, count = 1 }) end if BenillaScriptLogFrame and BenillaScriptLogFrame:IsVisible() then BenillaScriptLog_Update() end end
-- The chain: the log first, guarded so a fault in it cannot stop the stock handler. local benillaStockErrorHandler = geterrorhandler() seterrorhandler(function(message) pcall(BenillaScriptLog_Record, message) return benillaStockErrorHandler(message) end)
-- `strsub` counts bytes, so the cut backs up over UTF-8 continuation bytes (0x80..0xBF). function BenillaScriptLog_RowText(message) local cut = strfind(message, "\n", 1, 1) local head = message if cut then head = strsub(message, 1, cut - 1) end if strlen(head) > BENILLA_SCRIPTLOG_ROW_CHARS then local last = BENILLA_SCRIPTLOG_ROW_CHARS - 3 while last > 0 do local b = strbyte(head, last + 1) if not b or b < 128 or b >= 192 then break end last = last - 1 end head = strsub(head, 1, last) .. "..." end return head end
function BenillaScriptLog_Update() local shown = table.getn(BenillaScriptLog.rows) local total = BenillaScriptLog.total
local summary if total == 0 then summary = "No problems this session." elseif total > shown then summary = format("%d problems (%d older not kept)", total, total - shown) elseif total == 1 then summary = "1 problem" else summary = format("%d problems", total) end getglobal("BenillaScriptLogSummary"):SetText(summary)
local scrollFrame = getglobal("BenillaScriptLogListScrollFrame") FauxScrollFrame_Update(scrollFrame, shown, BENILLA_SCRIPTLOG_ROWS, BENILLA_SCRIPTLOG_ROW_HEIGHT) BenillaScrollTrough_Follow("BenillaScriptLogListScrollFrame") local offset = FauxScrollFrame_GetOffset(scrollFrame)
local selectedRow = nil for i = 1, BENILLA_SCRIPTLOG_ROWS do local button = getglobal("BenillaScriptLogRow" .. i) local index = offset + i local row = BenillaScriptLog.rows[index] if row then button.seq = row.seq button.message = row.message -- `#12 x1113`: one deduplicated failure that happened 1,113 times. local label = "#" .. row.seq if row.count > 1 then label = label .. " x" .. row.count end button.index:SetText(label) button.label:SetText(BenillaScriptLog_RowText(row.message)) button:Show() if row.seq == BenillaScriptLogSelected then selectedRow = button end else button.seq = nil button.message = nil button:Hide() end end
-- Hides when the row scrolls away, as the reference's CraftFrame does. local highlight = getglobal("BenillaScriptLogHighlightFrame") if selectedRow then highlight:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", selectedRow:GetName(), "TOPLEFT", 0, 0) highlight:Show() else highlight:Hide() end
BenillaScriptLog_UpdateDetail() end
-- The selected message in full, traceback and all, in a box a player can select and copy -- from. A text that has not changed is left alone: `SetText` collapses the selection, so a -- new error arriving must not undo one about to be copied. A different text takes the -- keyboard from the box, as a click on another row does. function BenillaScriptLog_UpdateDetail() local text = "" if BenillaScriptLogSelected then for _, row in ipairs(BenillaScriptLog.rows) do if row.seq == BenillaScriptLogSelected then text = row.message break end end end if text == "" then text = "Select a row above to read it in full." end local box = getglobal("BenillaScriptLogDetailText") if text ~= box.shown then box.shown = text box:ClearFocus() box:SetText(text) getglobal("BenillaScriptLogDetailRuler"):SetText(text) end end
-- The box is read-only: a player's edit is undone. The restore's own `SetText` raises -- another change, which finds the text equal and stops; `SetText` of an equal text does -- nothing. The selection an edit replaced is put back, so Ctrl+C still copies it all. function BenillaScriptLogDetail_OnTextChanged() local shown = this.shown or "" if this:GetText() ~= shown then this:SetText(shown) this:HighlightText() end ScrollingEdit_OnTextChanged(getglobal("BenillaScriptLogDetailScroll")) end
-- A multi-line box keeps the height it is given, and its own text region is pinned to its -- corners, so the ruler, a FontString of the same font and width, measures the wrapped -- text. The box takes that height, or the pane's when the text is shorter, so a click -- anywhere in the pane lands in it. Rects resolve after Lua runs, so this is re-measured -- every frame, and the child is sized to the ruler, as it was to the text before. function BenillaScriptLogFrame_OnUpdate() BenillaScroll_ResizeChild("BenillaScriptLogDetailScroll", { "BenillaScriptLogDetailRuler" }) local box = getglobal("BenillaScriptLogDetailText") local height = getglobal("BenillaScriptLogDetailRuler"):GetHeight() local pane = getglobal("BenillaScriptLogDetailScroll"):GetHeight() - BENILLA_SCRIPTLOG_DETAIL_INSET if height < pane then height = pane end if math.abs(box:GetHeight() - height) >= 1 then box:SetHeight(height) end end
function BenillaScriptLogRow_OnClick(button) if not button.seq then return end if BenillaScriptLogSelected == button.seq then BenillaScriptLogSelected = nil else BenillaScriptLogSelected = button.seq end BenillaScriptLog_Update() end
function BenillaScriptLogFrame_OnLoad() -- Masks the square icon to the portrait ring. SetPortraitToTexture("BenillaScriptLogFramePortrait", "Interface\\Icons\\INV_Misc_Note_01") -- The ruler only measures; the box draws the text. getglobal("BenillaScriptLogDetailRuler"):SetAlpha(0) end
-- The list frame's OnVerticalScroll repaints. function BenillaScriptLogFrame_OnMouseWheel(delta) BenillaFauxScrollFrame_OnMouseWheel(getglobal("BenillaScriptLogListScrollFrame"), delta) end
-- ── Entry points ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function BenillaScriptLog_Toggle() local frame = getglobal("BenillaScriptLogFrame") if frame:IsVisible() then HideUIPanel(frame) else ShowUIPanel(frame) end end
-- `/errors clear`: keeps the numbering, so a number never names two failures. function BenillaScriptLog_Clear() BenillaScriptLog.rows = {} BenillaScriptLogSelected = nil if getglobal("BenillaScriptLogFrame"):IsVisible() then BenillaScriptLog_Update() end DEFAULT_CHAT_FRAME:AddMessage("Script log cleared.", 1.0, 1.0, 0.0) end

-- Deviation: 1.12 has no `/reload` (later clients added it; 1.12 reloads through -- `/console reloadui`); kept so a player can reload the interface after toggling addons. SLASH_BENILLA_RELOAD1 = "/reload" SlashCmdList["BENILLA_RELOAD"] = function() ReloadUI() end
-- `/errors` toggles the log and `/errors clear` empties it; `/err` is the short form. SLASH_BENILLA_ERRORS1 = "/errors" SLASH_BENILLA_ERRORS2 = "/err" SlashCmdList["BENILLA_ERRORS"] = function(msg) local arg = string.lower((string.gsub(msg or "", "^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1"))) if arg == "clear" then BenillaScriptLog_Clear() else BenillaScriptLog_Toggle() end end
